answer: Because the sonnet cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the nadir ledger, the ocean audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 22 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The deposit is 20 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
